title: $\epsilon$-Seg++: Ensembling Across Hierarchy and Training Time for Label-Efficient EM Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32290v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semantic segmentation of electron microscopy (EM) volumes is a central step in quantitative cell biology, but dense voxel-wise annotation is prohibitively expensive. $\epsilon$-Seg showed that a hierarchical variational autoencoder trained on sparsely annotated voxels can yield competitive segmentations, but it classifies from its topmost latent level only and operates exclusively on 2D patches. We introduce $\epsilon$-Seg++, which places a semantic expert at every level of the hierarchy and consolidates their predictions with a parameter-free product of experts. We further enable 3D inputs through a leakage-free sub-volume splitting protocol, which allows 2D and 3D models to be compared under identical sparse supervision. Because validation labels are just as scarce as training labels, we treat checkpoint selection as part of the method and average the top-ranked checkpoints, a second ensemble, this time across training time. translated_title: ε-Seg++：跨层级与训练时间的集成方法实现高效标签的电子显微镜分割
translated_abstract: 电子显微镜（EM）体数据的语义分割是定量细胞生物学的核心步骤，但密集的体素级标注成本极其昂贵。ε-Seg 已经证明，在稀疏标注体素上训练的层次化变分自编码器可以获得具有竞争力的分割结果，但它仅从最顶层的潜在层级进行分类，且只能在 2D 图像块上运行。我们提出了 ε-Seg++，它在层次结构的每一层都放置了一个语义专家，并通过无参数的专家乘积来整合它们的预测。我们进一步通过无泄漏的子体积划分协议实现了 3D 输入，使得 2D 和 3D 模型能够在相同的稀疏监督下进行比较。由于验证标签与训练标签同样稀缺，我们将检查点选择作为方法的一部分，对排名靠前的检查点进行平均，这构成了第二个集成——即跨训练时间的集成。在 B（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ε-Seg++ 通过在层次化变分自编码器的每一层级引入语义专家并用无参数专家乘积进行集成、支持无泄漏的 3D 子体积输入、以及跨训练时间对最优检查点进行集成，显著提升了稀疏标注条件下电子显微镜分割的效果。
en_tdlr: ε-Seg++ improves label-efficient EM segmentation by ensembling semantic experts at every hierarchy level via a parameter-free product of experts, enabling leakage-free 3D sub-volume inputs, and averaging top-ranked checkpoints as a second ensemble across training time.
